ai_description: Bank statements (SBI / IDBI) uploaded as Excel (.xlsx/.xls/.xlsb) or CSV - including compiled workbooks with one sheet per bank and many overlapping statement downloads pasted per sheet. Produces a customer-wise summary of CREDIT (CR) receipts only, de-duplicated across overlapping downloads, grouped A-Z with per-customer subtotals and a grand total. One output sheet per bank plus a combined 'All Banks' sheet.
